scene_target: Establish Artie's mundane life and sudden, absurd death.
goal: Introduce Artie and the catalyst for his isekai journey.
conflict: Artie vs. a malfunctioning vending machine.
end_condition: Artie is electrocuted and the scene fades to white/void.
location_start: A cramped, fluorescent-lit office breakroom with a buzzing vending machine.
location_end: An endless expanse of white light and floating geometric shapes.
transition_in_text: Artie stands before the breakroom vending machine, his last five dollars and his sanity on the line.
transition_out_text: The world dissolves into static and high-voltage blue light as the surge hits.

last_scene: Artie Penhaligon dies in his office breakroom after a lethal electrical surge from a malfunctioning vending machine.
He transitions to the Character Creation Void, a blinding white expanse of unrendered data.
Despite his death, Artie successfully retrieved his bag of salt-and-vinegar chips, which he still holds in the void.
key_events: Artie attempts to buy chips from a malfunctioning vending machine.
The machine eats his money and jams the snack.
Artie reaches into the machine to retrieve the bag of salt-and-vinegar chips.
A puddle of soda and a frayed wire cause a lethal electrical surge.
Artie dies and transitions to the Character Creation Void.
Artie wakes up in the void, still holding the chips.
